explanation.text:
LIFECARE ASA (org.nr 990 251 657) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 2006-09-04, registered 2006-09-20. Business address: Ytrebygdsvegen 215, 5258 BLOMSTERDALEN. Main industry (NACE): 72.100 Forskning og eksperimentell utvikling innenfor naturvitenskap og teknikk. Registered employees: 9 (as of 2026-08-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 11,028,000; operating result NOK -119,626,000; net result NOK -108,088,000; total assets NOK 68,726,000; equity NOK -8,761,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 6,640,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Joacim Holter; board chair Morten Foros Krohnstad; 4 other board members. Sub-units registered: 1. Website: www.lifecare.no. The website describes the company as: "Lifecare creates implantable nanobiosensors for accurate, continuous glucose and biomarker monitoring, transforming lives through innovative medical technology." LEI: 254900D88MYGZ7JD5P39 (ACTIVE). Wikipedia: https://no.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lifecare_AS.
